panels.title: Pools
panels.description: Pool state from zpool status, every 5 minutes.

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: SMART overall health. A disk in standby keeps its last reading, so the collector never wakes it.

panels.title: Last scrub
panels.description: Time since each pool last finished a scrub. Due after 30 days, run in the weeknight off-peak window.

panels.title: Failed units
panels.description: systemctl --state=failed, every 5 minutes.

panels.title: Booted image
panels.description: Age of the booted bootc image. Updates apply daily, so an old image means updates are stuck.

panels.title: Collector age
panels.description: Time since each host-metrics collector last wrote. zfs and units run every 5 minutes, smart and bootc every 30.

panels.title: Devices

targets.expr: max by (pool, vdev, type, class, state) (zfs_vdev_state)
max by (pool, vdev, type, class, state) (zfs_vdev_read_errors * on (pool, vdev) group_left (state) zfs_vdev_state)
max by (pool, vdev, type, class, state) (zfs_vdev_write_errors * on (pool, vdev) group_left (state) zfs_vdev_state)
max by (pool, vdev, type, class, state) (zfs_vdev_checksum_errors * on (pool, vdev) group_left (state) zfs_vdev_state)

panels.description: Every vdev in each pool. Read, write and checksum error counts are since the pool was imported or last cleared.

panels.title: Scans
panels.description: The latest scrub or resilver per pool. A scrub pauses when the off-peak window closes and resumes in the next one.

panels.title: Pool space
panels.description: Allocated over raw pool size. ZFS slows down above about 80%.

panels.title: Fragmentation
panels.description: Free space fragmentation. High values slow writes on a nearly full pool.

panels.title: SMART
panels.description: Read every 30 minutes, skipping disks in standby. Reallocated, pending and uncorrectable sectors are the early signs of a failing drive. CRC errors point at the cable. Wear is NVMe percentage used.

panels.title: Sector problems
panels.description: Reallocated, pending and offline uncorrectable sector counts. Any growth is worth a closer look.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: ARC counts as used memory to Linux but shrinks under pressure. It is capped at 2 GiB in modprobe.d/zfs.conf.

panels.title: Temperatures

targets.expr: (node_hwmon_temp_celsius * on (chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label or on (chip, sensor) label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius, "label", "$1", "sensor", "(.+)")) * on (chip) group_left (chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names or on (chip, sensor) label_replace((node_hwmon_temp_celsius * on (chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label or on (chip, sensor) label_replace(node_hwmon_temp_celsius, "label", "$1", "sensor", "(.+)")), "chip_name", "$1", "chip", "(.+)")

panels.description: hwmon sensors, such as CPU package and NVMe.

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Reads above the line, writes below.

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Share of time each disk had I/O in flight. Flat at zero means the disk was idle.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Received above the line, sent below.

panels.title: ARC hit ratio
panels.description: Share of ZFS reads served from memory.

panels.title: CPU frequency
panels.description: Low and flat outside the off-peak window means the box is idling as tuned.

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description: The OS disk outside ZFS.
